title: Pull requests that each add registry entries merge in any order
statement: A new quality registry entry is its own file, config/quality_registry.d/<ID>.json, loaded together with config/quality_registry.json; the traceability document is rendered on demand and not committed; and no test pins the list or count of registry ids. Two pull requests that each add entries therefore change disjoint paths and merge cleanly in either order.
failure_mode: Every pull request appended to the same registry array, regenerated the same committed traceability document and edited the same hard-coded id list, so each merge put every other open pull request back into conflict: on 2026-10-28 all 26 open pull requests conflicted with main, 22 of them only in those shared files.
